passive.name: Knight's Morale
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper launches a **Special Attack**, their **Physical Sheer DMG** increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Cloud Flow
passive.text: CRIT Rate increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper launches an **EX Special Attack**, the character gains 1 stack of **Qingming Companion** effect, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. On entering combat, immediately gain 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of the **Qingming Companion** effect increases the equipper's **Ether DMG** by **8/9.2/10.4/11.6/12.8%**, and increases Ultimate and EX Special Attack **Ether Sheer DMG** by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

passive.name: Summoning Arcanum
passive.text: When the equipper activates an **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's DMG by **4/4.6/5.2/5.8/6.4%**, up to 3 stacks, and lasting 20s. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by **6.5/7.5/8.5/9.4/10.4%**.

passive.name: Metal Cat Claws
passive.text: Increases **Physical DMG** by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The equipper's DMG increases by **25/31.5/38/44/50%** when hitting the enemy from behind.

passive.name: Caged Fire
passive.text: The equipper's **Fire DMG** increases by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%**. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%** for 5s.

passive.name: Ingenious Craft
passive.text: Upon launching an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by **16/18.4/20.8/23.2/25.6%** for 12s. Additionally, if the target's current HP is below 50% of their Max HP, **EX Special Attack** DMG increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Easy Strides
passive.text: When launching a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect. Each stack increases the equipper's Sheer Force by **80/92/104/116/128**, stacking up to 3 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

substatLine: CRIT RATE > CRIT DMG = HP% > Flat HP > Flat ATK
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Special Attack > Basic Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Knight's Technique
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
During the 4th hit, press Special Attack to use **Special Attack: Drive Suppression**, reducing HP consumption by 50%.
Restores a small amount of HP on hit.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight
entries.text:
With enough **Determination**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Charges forward on the motorcycle, then fires a laser beam, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Close Call!
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Through the Galaxy
entries.text:
During **Special Attack: Drive Suppression**, drag the joystick or hold Dodge to activate:
Drifts with the motorcycle, enabling **Perfect Dodges** for a brief duration.
If a **Perfect Dodge** is successfully triggered, it immediately chains into **Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin**.
During this skill, continue dragging the joystick or holding Dodge to continue drifting.
During this skill, the duration of **Special Attack: Drive Suppression** will continue, and upon reaching the maximum duration, it automatically chains into **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**.
If the skill ends early, it automatically chains into **Special Attack: Run Wild**.
Character is briefly invulnerable and Anti-Interrupt Level increases during this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Performs a quick forward slash, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Duel King
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon, dealing **Physical DMG**.
If this skill is triggered via a **Perfect Dodge**, hitting an enemy restores 10% of Max HP, and it can be chained into the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Knight's Technique**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin
entries.text:
During **Dodge: Through the Galaxy**, trigger a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Spins with the bike to deal **Physical DMG** to surrounding enemies.
After using this skill, it automatically chains into **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Starlight - Power of Bonds
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon ahead, dealing **Physical DMG**. When HP is above 25%, this skill is replaced with **Special Attack: Drive Suppression**. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Hero's Entrance
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Villain's Exit
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Kicks the motorcycle at the target, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Drive Suppression
entries.text:
When HP is above 25%, press Special Attack to activate:
Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing **Physical DMG**.
If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the attack and restoring 5 **Determination**.
After triggering a block, immediately chains into **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**.
After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Run Wild
entries.text:
Triggers automatically when **Dodge: Through the Galaxy** is interrupted:
Kicks his motorcycle at enemies, dealing **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, it can be chained into **Dodge Counter: Duel King**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie
entries.text:
Triggers automatically when **Special Attack: Drive Suppression** reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
Lifts the motorcycle to attack enemies, dealing **Physical DMG**.
On hit, restores an additional 8 **Determination**.
After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold EX Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork**.
After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into **Special Attack: Run Wild**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline, hold EX Special Attack to activate:
Slams down with the motorcycle, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Restores 30% of Max HP upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork
entries.text:
After activating **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie** and with enough Adrenaline, press or hold EX Special Attack to activate:
Uses the motorcycle and hand cannon for a combined attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, restore 15% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, gains 15 **Determination**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Leaps into the air and delivers a flying kick at the target, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve
entries.text:
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All **Physical DMG** Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press Special Attack to consume HP and activate **Special Attack: Drive Suppression**. While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by **90%** for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains **Determination** when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. **Determination** regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**, activating **Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger**, or triggering a block restores additional **Determination**. Triggering a **Perfect Dodge** by any means restores 3 **Determination**. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When **Determination** is greater than or equal to 100, hold Basic Attack to consume 100 **Determination** and activate **Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight**.
Hitting an enemy with **Basic Attack: Knight's Technique** restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with **Dodge Counter: Duel King** activated through a **Perfect Dodge** restores HP. Using **EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels** or **EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork** restores HP.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Blazing Starlight
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Stun**, **Defense**, or **Support** character:
Hitting an enemy with **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**, the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Knight's Technique**, **Chain Attack**, or **Ultimate** grants 1 stack of **Starlight** for 45s, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, Only one stack can be obtained per use of a skill. Each stack increases the DMG of **Chain Attacks**, **Ultimates**, **EX Special Attacks**, and **Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight** by 20%.

entries.name: Heroic Entrance
entries.text:
**Core Passive: Knight's Resolve** restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield.
Hitting an enemy with an **EX Special Attack** causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% **Physical RES** for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

entries.name: Wasteland Automaton
entries.text:
Increases the DMG dealt by **Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight**, **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**, and **Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick** by 50%.
Activating **EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork**, **EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels**, or hitting a Stunned enemy with **Special Attack: Drive Suppression** grants the **Turbocharged** effect:
**Special Attack: Drive Suppression** consumes this effect to immediately follow up with **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of **Turbocharged** can be held.

entries.name: Knight's Chivalry
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Flames of Justice
entries.text:
While in combat, each use of **Special Attack: Drive Suppression** increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times, and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.

entries.name: Radiant Armaments
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Starlight Knight
entries.text:
**Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick** and **Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight**'s Sheer DMG increases by 18%.
Landing the 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Knight's Technique**, **EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie**, or **Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger** grants 1 stack of **Brilliant Starlight**, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use.
When using **Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick** or **Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight**, consumes up to 2 stacks of **Brilliant Starlight**, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional **Physical DMG**.
